name: Bow of Nylea

abilities.text: Attacking creatures you control have deathtouch.

notes: The four bullets belong to the 'Choose one -' line and are the four modes of the choose-mode effect (a bullet is not an oracle line of its own, README 'Claiming lines'). Mode 4 is return-from-graveyard with target: true, count 4, optional - real targets chosen on activation and re-checked on resolution (CR 115.1, 608.2b), which is what 'up to four TARGET cards from your graveyard' means; the previous draft used a resolution-time chooser and a judge rejected it. APPROXIMATION: 'in any order' is not modelled - the cards go to the bottom in the order they were targeted, and the format has no decision for ordering a set of cards put on the bottom of a library.

issues: Put up to four target cards from your graveyard on the bottom of your library in any order. — expected The controller orders the up-to-four cards as they go to the bottom of the library. — scripted return-from-graveyard {what:{}, to:'library-bottom', target:true, count:4, optional:true}. game.ts:1465 moveTo(o,'library','bottom') in the order the cards were targeted; there is no ordering decision in the vocabulary. Disclosed APPROXIMATION in notes. Everything else on the line is exact: legal.ts:80 turns target:true into a real graveyard-card spec with who:'you', count 4, optional -> 'up to four target cards from your graveyard', chosen on activation and re-checked on resolution. — CR CR 115.1, 608.2b, 401.4

{1}{G}, {T}: Choose one — — expected Four modes, one chosen on activation, at instant speed. — scripted choose-mode count 1 with the four modes in printed order; cost {1}{G} + tap; no sorcerySpeed. legal.ts:255 enumerates modeCombos(4,1) so every mode is offerable. The blind harness's failure on modes 2 and 4 is a harness mode-selection limit (it takes the first mode whose targets fit), not a script defect.

Attacking creatures you control have deathtouch. — expected Static, continuous, applies only while the creature is attacking and only to yours. — scripted anthem 0/0, filter {attacking:true}, scope 'you-control', keywords ['deathtouch'] — correct; the blind attacking/blocking pair both pass. — CR CR 604.3, 702.2b

Put up to four target cards from your graveyard on the bottom of your library in any order. — expected Up to four targeted cards from YOUR graveyard go to the bottom of your library, and their controller orders them. — scripted return-from-graveyard {what:{}, to:'library-bottom', target:true, count:4, optional:true}. legal.ts:80 adds who:'you' when anyGraveyard is absent, so the target pool is your graveyard only; count 4 + optional gives 'up to four'; game.ts:1454 uses the targets picked on activation and re-checks legality (CR 608.2b). The only gap is 'in any order' - the cards go to the bottom in target order, which is not a free choice. Minor, documented. — CR CR 115.1 / 608.2b / 701.20

Attacking creatures you control have deathtouch. — expected Continuous, dynamic: a creature you control has deathtouch only while it is attacking. — scripted static anthem +0/+0, filter {attacking:true}, scope 'you-control', keywords ['deathtouch']. characteristics.ts:366-373 checks same-controller and matchesFilter (f.attacking, line 262) on every read, so the grant appears when the creature attacks and is gone while it blocks. Correct. — CR CR 613.1c

{1}{G}, {T}: Choose one - — expected The mode is chosen as the ability is put on the stack, and only that mode's targets are chosen. — scripted choose-mode count 1 with the four bullets as modes. legal.ts:255 enumerates one action per mode (modeCombos k=1) and game.ts:890 expands only the chosen mode's effects, so mode and targets are locked at activation. The blind 2/6 failure is a harness limitation (autoPickMode, game.ts:2338), not a script defect. — CR CR 601.2b / 700.2

Bow of Nylea deals 2 damage to target creature with flying. / You gain 3 life. / Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. — expected 2 damage from the Bow to a flying creature; you gain exactly 3 life; one +1/+1 counter on any target creature. — scripted damage 2 to {kind:'creature',filter:{flying:true}} (f.flying, characteristics.ts:264), gain-life 3 who 'you', counters '+1/+1' amount 1 on target creature. All three match, damage source is the Bow. — CR CR 119.3 / 121.1
